register.labelZh: SQUEEZE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: squeeze in 和 squeeze into something 可以描述擠進滿座巴士、小型汽車、擠迫的升降機或其他狹窄空間。；你可以把另一本書塞進袋中、把另一張椅子放進房間,或在已排滿的時間表中安排多一名病人。；當競爭、高昂成本或更強大的團體迫使某人退出市場、地方或活動時,可以使用 squeezesomebody or something out。；squeeze something out 可以自然地描述把布、毛巾、海綿或地拖中的水擠走。
register.summaryEn: Squeeze in and squeeze into something help you describe entering a full bus, a small car, a crowded lift or another narrow space. You can squeeze another book into a bag, squeeze another chair into a room or squeeze a patient into a full timetable. Squeeze somebody or something out is useful when competition, high costs or stronger groups make someone leave a market, place or activity. Squeeze something out gives you a natural way to talk about pressing water from a cloth, towel, sponge or mop.

fixedVariable.variableZh: squeeze in 本身可以完整使用;squeeze into something 則補充擠進的地方。squeeze somebody/something in 本身也可以完整使用;squeeze somebody/something intosomething 則補充把人或物塞進哪裏。；squeeze somebody/something out 本身可以完整使用;out of something 則補充被迫退出的地方、活動或市場。；(較大的公司迫使小公司退出。)She squeezed the wet cloth out.(她把濕布中的水擠走。)With him, her, it or them, follow these examples:squeeze it insqueeze them outsqueeze it out使用 him、her、it 或 them 時,請按照以上例子把代名詞放在 SQUEEZE 和 IN/OUT 之間。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Squeeze in can stand alone. Squeeze into something adds the place that a person enters. We squeezed in. We squeezed into the crowded lift. Squeeze somebody/something in can also stand alone. Squeeze somebody/something into something adds the place or situation where that person or thing is fitted. We squeezed the bags in. We squeezed the bags into the car. Squeeze somebody/something out can stand alone. Out of something adds the place, activity or market that the person or thing is forced to leave. The small shop was squeezed out. The small shop was squeezed out of the market. Read the context carefully because squeeze something out can express two different ideas: Larger companies squeezed the small firm out.
